description_en: Queries the picture information captured by an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询IPC设备获取的图片信息
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-device-picture-file --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id zLZyi6aOLyOSHa9hsPyD000000 --capture-id fdc576d03c094faea9fa10fbf48c0000 --thumb-width 100 --expire-time 60 --picture-type 1 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDevicePictureFile

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page of the IoT Platform console or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view the information of all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>

parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the picture generated when a capture event occurs:
- For pictures captured by active triggering, refer to [TriggerCapturePicture](~~107914~~) for the picture ID.
- For pictures captured by intelligent alert events, refer to [QueryDeviceEvent](~~107916~~) for the picture ID.
parameters.description_zh:

- 智能告警事件触发抓图时，图片ID请参见[QueryDeviceEvent](~~107916~~)。

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
